personality.traits: I judge people by their actions, not their words.
personality.ideals: Sincerity. There's no good in pretending to be something I'm not.
personality.bonds: Everything I do is for the common people.
personality.flaws: I'm too greedy for my own good. I can't resist taking a risk if there's money involved.
